Bike shops in Tucson: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Tucson that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Bike shops in Tucson: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Fair Wheel Bikes

    1110 E 6th St, Tucson, AZ 85719 · 520-884-9018

    repairrentalpartsfitting

    High-end road and gravel shop near the university; rents road, gravel, mountain and e-bikes and offers route advice

  2. Transit Cycles

    267 S Avenida del Convento, Bldg 10, Tucson, AZ 85745 · 520-396-4525

    repairparts

    Woman-owned shop in the Mercado district beside the Loop; commuter, gravel and mountain focus, services road and most e-bikes. Closed Mondays

  3. Ajo Bikes

    1301 E Ajo Way, Ste 117, Tucson, AZ 85713 · 520-294-1434

    repairparts

    Family shop for 50-plus years on the south side, near the airport; four certified mechanics, recumbents and trikes too

  4. BICAS

    2001 N 7th Ave, Tucson, AZ 85705 · 520-628-7950

    repairrentalpartsdiy

    Nonprofit community bike shop since 1989: DIY stands with mechanic help, used parts, refurbished bikes and rentals. Thursday-Sunday

  5. Bicycle Ranch Tucson

    7090 N Oracle Rd #156, Tucson, AZ 85704 · 520-219-4311

    repairpartsfitting

    Full-service shop on the north side near Oro Valley and the Catalina foothills; services all makes. No rentals listed
